title: The goat demoted by the British Army
estilo_visual: fotografías de dominio público o licencia libre

sources.cita_corta: BBC News, 24-jun-2006: Gruff justice as Billy is demoted.
Countryfile.com: This animal served as a lance corporal in the British Army, before receiving a demotion.

scenes.narration: June 2006. A parade for the Queen's birthday. Ambassadors in the front row. And a British Army lance corporal decides to headbutt a drummer.
scenes.image_credit: Ilustración generada con IA (no es una foto de Billy).

scenes.narration: The lance corporal was William Windsor, Billy to his friends: a Kashmir goat, a ranking member of the 1st Battalion, the Royal Welsh, a gift from Queen Elizabeth the Second in 2001.
scenes.image_credit: Geifr Pen y Gogarth, Llandudno - semi feral Kashmir goats on Pen y Gogarth (recently translated to 'Great Orme'), Llandudno, Wales 03. Llywelyn2000, CC BY-SA 4.0. Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Geifr_Pen_y_Gogarth,_Llandudno_-_semi_feral_Kashmir_goats_on_Pen_y_Gogarth_(recently_translated_to_%27Great_Orme%27),_Llandudno,_Wales_03.jpg

scenes.narration: It was his first overseas posting: the Episkopi base, in Cyprus. The parade was on June 16, in front of the ambassadors of Spain, the Netherlands and Sweden, and the Argentine commander of UN forces in Cyprus.
scenes.image_credit: Episkopi Cyprus - road. Radosław Botev, CC BY 3.0 pl. Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Episkopi_Cyprus_-_road.jpg

scenes.narration: Billy wouldn't keep in step, broke ranks and, according to Countryfile, tried to headbutt a drummer. His handler, Lance Corporal Dai Davies, 22, known as the goat major, couldn't keep him in line.
scenes.image_credit: RoyalRegimentWalesGoat gobeirne. Greg O'Beirne, CC BY 2.5. Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:RoyalRegimentWalesGoat_gobeirne.jpg

scenes.narration: The charges: lack of decorum and disobeying a direct order. He was demoted from lance corporal to fusilier, and soldiers no longer had to stand to attention when he passed.
scenes.image_credit: Military goat. Southbanksteve from London, UK, CC BY-SA 2.0. Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Military_goat.jpg

scenes.narration: A Canadian animal rights group protested that he was just acting the goat. Three months later, at the Alma Day parade, he marched perfectly and got his rank back. A captain said he'd had all summer to reflect on his behaviour. In 2009 he retired to Whipsnade Zoo. Would you have promoted him again?
scenes.image_credit: Royal Welsh Fusiliers Goat. Robert French, Public domain. Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Royal_Welsh_Fusiliers_Goat.jpg
